parts.text: What is the immediate field recovery protocol when a cashier encounters an ERR-PAY-4001 EMV contactless payment freeze, and how do we ensure the customer is not double-charged?

To recover from an ERR-PAY-4001 EMV payment freeze on the Toshiba TCx 810, perform the certified field recovery protocol: 1. Power cycle the contactless payment terminal reader. 2. Verify in the register journal that the transaction was voided or aborted before initiating a new charge to prevent double-charging. Refer to the certified Toshiba TCx 810 technical documentation link.

How do I clear a paper jam and knife cutter lockup on a Diebold Nixdorf BEETLE A1150 terminal reporting ERR-DN-PRNT-24V?

For Diebold Nixdorf BEETLE A1150 reporting error ERR-DN-PRNT-24V (printer knife cutter lockup): 1. Turn off printer power before manual manipulation. 2. Open the printer service cover and rotate the manual feed knob to clear the cutter blade lockup. 3. Remove jammed thermal receipt roll remnants and perform a test feed. Link: https://storage.cloud.google.com/cymbal-ops-runbooks/diebold_nixdorf_beetle_a1150_service.pdf
